verdict.rationale: Khoj runs agents that can execute Python code and search the web, so containment is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never says where that code runs or whether it is sandboxed, and documents no permission modes or security-oriented tool policies. Per-agent tool selection, conversation file filters and Docker-based server installation are adjacent features or host-platform options, not documented containment of risky tool runs.

support.subject: As a security engineer, risky tool runs are containable — container/VM sandboxing, tool policies, or permission modes that limit what the agent can touch
